subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: cite.py --check 15.2 'National functions. These are of the class and category national. National functions have an implicit usage national.' => OK §15.2 3). All three clauses met. (a) CLASS AND CATEGORY NATIONAL: IntrinsicCatalog.cs#CategoryOf maps IntrinsicType.National => PicCategory.National, cited on the member to §15.66.1 ('the type of the function is national'), and it is the SINGLE mapping both the declared and the argument-resolved paths use. The argument-resolved path matters here: IntrinsicResultType.Resolve's FollowsArgument1 / FollowsUniformArguments / FollowsConcatArguments rules turn ten-plus functions national on a national argument-1, and IntrinsicResultTypeDriftTests re-derives that population from specs/ISO_COBOL.md so a §15.x.1 table cannot be missed — the repair of kb/Work PB15, whose measured symptom was MOVE FUNCTION TRIM(national-item) TO alphanumeric-item compiling clean. (b) IMPLICIT USAGE NATIONAL is modelled and read: IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#StaticUsageOf answers Usage.National for a National-result nested call, the axis §15.18.3 r2 and §15.19.3 r6 key on. (c) 'represented in the national coded character set in effect at runtime': one invariant national repertoire, UTF-16 one code unit per national position, documented in docs/CONFORMANCE.md items 33/188 (D-N1). TESTS: 2002/national_intrinsics is the positive golden; the pb15-* negatives and max_national_result_to_an pin the §14.9.25.3 Table-16 refusal of a national function result into an alphanumeric receiver, which is what the category claim BUYS.
